question:
Vereenvoudig SONDER die gebruik van 'n sakrekenaar:
$$\frac{\sin 120^\circ \cdot \cos 210^\circ \cdot \tan 315^\circ \cdot \cos 27^\circ}{\sin 63^\circ \cdot \cos 540^\circ}$$
memo:
$\sin 120^\circ = \sin(180^\circ - 60^\circ) = \sin 60^\circ = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$ $\checkmark$
$\cos 210^\circ = \cos(180^\circ + 30^\circ) = -\cos 30^\circ = -\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$ $\checkmark$
$\tan 315^\circ = \tan(360^\circ - 45^\circ) = -\tan 45^\circ = -1$ $\checkmark$
$\cos 27^\circ = \sin(90^\circ - 27^\circ) = \sin 63^\circ$ $\checkmark$
$\cos 540^\circ = \cos(540^\circ - 360^\circ) = \cos 180^\circ = -1$ $\checkmark$
Substitusie: $\frac{\left(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\right)\left(-\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\right)(-1)(\sin 63^\circ)}{(\sin 63^\circ)(-1)}$ $\checkmark$
$= -\frac{3}{4}$ $\checkmark$

question:
Bewys die identiteit:
$$\frac{1}{\cos\theta} - \frac{\cos\theta}{1 + \sin\theta} = \tan\theta$$
memo:
L.K. = $\frac{1+\sin\theta - \cos^2\theta}{\cos\theta(1+\sin\theta)}$ $\checkmark$ (vind gemene noemer)
$= \frac{1+\sin\theta - (1-\sin^2\theta)}{\cos\theta(1+\sin\theta)}$ $\checkmark$ (gebruik $\cos^2\theta = 1-\sin^2\theta$)
$= \frac{1+\sin\theta - 1 + \sin^2\theta}{\cos\theta(1+\sin\theta)}$ $\checkmark$
$= \frac{\sin\theta + \sin^2\theta}{\cos\theta(1+\sin\theta)}$ $\checkmark$
$= \frac{\sin\theta(1+\sin\theta)}{\cos\theta(1+\sin\theta)}$ $\checkmark$
$= \frac{\sin\theta}{\cos\theta} = \tan\theta = \text{R.K.}$
